notes: Declarative when/why/chronology for the air-gapped Splunk MCP tool surface. Single source the deterministic planner reviews an LLM-proposed chronology against. Execution stays gated by MCP_GLOBAL_EXECUTION_ENABLED + server flags + HIL/COE regardless of this playbook.

splunk_get_info.when: Once per session, before any discovery or search, to confirm the instance is reachable and read its version/server identity.
splunk_get_info.why: Establishes connectivity + capability baseline so later steps fail fast if the instance is unreachable.

splunk_get_indexes.when: After readiness, to learn which indexes the authenticated principal can access.
splunk_get_indexes.why: SPL must target an allowed, existing index; the index list bounds what the search can scope.

splunk_get_metadata.when: Before building SPL, to retrieve hosts/sources/sourcetypes for the candidate index(es).
splunk_get_metadata.why: Sourcetype + field context is needed to render a valid, relevant SPL template; prevents guessing field names.

splunk_get_index_info.when: Only when a specific target index is already known and detailed properties (size, time bounds, retention) matter.
splunk_get_index_info.why: Refines time-window and scoping decisions for the search; optional when no single index is targeted.

splunk_get_knowledge_objects.when: Before search, to discover vetted saved searches, macros, data models, and eventtypes that may already encode the detection.
splunk_get_knowledge_objects.why: Prefer reusing a governed saved search/macro over authoring raw SPL; surfaces existing detection coverage.

splunk_run_query.when: Last, only with an approved, validator-normalized SPL and after the execution gate + HIL/COE allow it.
splunk_run_query.why: Returns the actual evidence rows. The single execution hop; everything before it is read-only context.

splunk_get_user_info.when: On demand when RBAC scoping or attribution of the current authenticated principal (self) is needed; not part of the linear discovery→search chain.
splunk_get_user_info.why: Confirms the acting identity for RBAC decisions and audit attribution. Read-only, returns the current user only.

splunk_get_user_list.why: Enumerates all users (directory recon + PII). Out of scope for read-only evidence collection.

saia_generate_spl.why: Conditional (Splunk AI Assistant for SPL app) + generative. SPL authoring stays in the governed template/validator path.

saia_ask_splunk_question.why: Conditional + generative free-form Q&A; out of governed scope.
